apps.name: Audia
apps.subtitle: YouTube Music client for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
A free and open source YouTube Music client for iOS.

• No ads
• Stream songs and videos from YouTube Music
• Hardware-accelerated video mode
• Background playback with lock screen controls
• 10-band equalizer & audio normalization
• Spotify & YouTube Music playlist import
• Persistent queue & playback history
• Library sync (playlists, albums, artists, podcasts, liked songs)
• Offline downloads & auto-downloads
• AMOLED dark UI with custom accent colors

Requires iOS 16.0 or later and a YouTube Music account.
